neet_phy_u08_t04_1.working: Work per cycle W = 800 - 600 = 200 J. Efficiency = W/Q_hot = 200/800 = 25%.

neet_phy_u08_t04_2.working: Heat extracted from the cold body Q_cold = 1000 - 200 = 800 J. COP = Q_cold/W = 800/200 = 4.

neet_phy_u08_t04_3.working: For a reversed engine, COP = (1 - η)/η = 0.75/0.25 = 3.

neet_phy_u08_t04_4.working: Even with no losses, some heat must be rejected to a cold sink (Kelvin-Planck), so η < 1. A is false and R is true.

neet_phy_u08_t04_5.working: I: COP = (1 - η)/η, which increases as η decreases, so I is true. II: Q_hot = Q_cold + W > Q_cold, so II is true.
